$comment: Redis Streams between API and bot (plan.md, section 1). Entries have one field 'data' holding JSON. The API writes events through the outbox relay; the bot reads with consumer group 'bot' and acknowledges (XACK) after handling.

bot.updated.$comment: name, token, autostart or profile changed

commands.changed.$comment: several commands, groups or enabled states at once

bot.presence.$comment: status, activity, custom status or rotation changed; the bot reads bot_profiles.presence and applies it

bot.guild_access.$comment: closed invites or the allowed servers of a bot changed; the bot leaves every server that is not allowed

timed.changed.$comment: timed events, bot time zone or default server changed; the bot reloads its schedules

webhook.called.name: string
webhook.called.$comment: a webhook was called (or tested); the bot runs the custom events of type webhook with config webhook = eventId or empty

sdk.policies.changed.$comment: admin switched an SDK permission on or off (sdk_policies); the bot restarts the plugins of every running bot

plugin.webhook.name: string
plugin.webhook.$comment: a plugin webhook was called (bothub.json services.webhooks, URL with HMAC token); the bot runs the plugin's webhooks[name] handler

plugins.changed.$comment: a plugin was installed, removed, switched on or off globally or for a bot (plugin_installs, bot_plugin_disabled); the bot restarts the plugins of every running bot

secrets.changed.$comment: global secrets or API endpoints changed; the bot drops its secret cache

core.restart.$comment: Resource overview: the NodeCore stops all bots and exits; Docker/supervisord starts it again. Ignored when older than 60 s (redelivered after the restart).

message.send.$comment: Message Builder: the bot sends saved message templateId (message_templates) to target, a channel ID or a Discord webhook URL (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...)

entry.errorKey: string, only when ok is false
